description: This file defines the PatientService class which provides methods to interact with the 'patients' table in a database via Supabase, including upserting patient data, retrieving a patient by user ID, and searching patients by name.

classes.name: PatientService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to access and manipulate patient data in the database.

methods.name: upsertPatient
methods.description: Inserts or updates a patient record in the database and returns the updated Patient object.

methods.name: getPatientByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a patient record matching the specified user ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: searchPatientsByName
methods.description: Searches for patients whose names match the given query pattern.
